title: ci: add artifact signing, provenance, SBOM and release-manifests for private-installer
author: Priya Rao
description: Motivation: Provide end-to-end CI for Private Installer releases that produces verifiable release artifacts (signed binaries, release-manifests, SBOMs and provenance). Customers deploying Private Installer require cryptographic guarantees about what is being installed and an auditable manifest for air-gapped environments. This PR implements automated artifact signing (cosign), SBOM generation (syft), and release-manifest generation and signing as part of the existing release pipeline. Changes include: 1) CI jobs to build installer artifacts and container images, 2) syft-based SBOM generation per artifact and packaging into release-manifests, 3) cosign signing of OCI images and release-manifests, 4) a deterministic release-manifests JSON schema and generator script, 5) terraform/helm chart tweaks so manifests can be consumed by the installer during offline installs. Checklist: - [x] add build jobs for installer binaries and images - [x] generate SBOMs with syft and attach to artifacts - [x] sign images/manifests with cosign using CI KMS-wrapped keys - [x] produce release-manifests containing artifact URLs, checksums, SBOM references and provenance metadata - [x] update private-installer README describing offline install flow - [x] add basic integration test for manifest validation Notes: The description below combines high-level design and operational notes. Signing: CI will use the existing KMS-backed signing key stored in the org vault; cosign keys are fetched at job runtime and never persisted on runners. The release-manifests are JSON files with fields: manifest_version, artifacts: [{name,image,checksum,sbom_url,provenance_url}], signed_manifest (base64 signature), and a provenance blob that ties the CI run, git SHA and build environment. Rollbacks & upgrades: release-manifests are versioned and the installer will validate signatures before performing upgrades; the manifest generator includes an optional previous_manifest pointer to support rollback validation. Migration: existing private-installer releases will be backfilled with a best-effort SBOM + signature for the last three releases. Backward compatibility: installer will accept unsigned manifests in a migration mode gated by an enterprise flag; default behavior for new releases requires signed manifests. Operational runbook: release engineers can trigger a re-sign or re-build via the release workflow; any signature operation requires 2 approvers on the Linear ticket. Related: ENG-1987 implements the manifest schema; SUP-421 is the customer request driving provenance requirements.

review_comments: Evan Martinez (review): Can we avoid writing cosign keys to disk on self-hosted runners? Suggest using 'cosign sign-blob --key <kms://...>' integration.
Author (Priya Rao): Good catch, updated job to use cosign KMS plugin and removed key write steps.
Sara Li (review): SBOM size exploded in one job run (~30MB). Please ensure artifacts are compressed and stored in the same release bucket to keep manifests atomic.
Author (Priya Rao): Added gzip step and upload to s3-release bucket; manifest references compressed sbom_url.
Tomás Alvarez (approval): LGTM modulo a minor docs update about migration mode. Approved.
CI Bot: release.yml job 'sign-artifacts' failed on first run due to registry rate limiting; re-run succeeded.
Security (automated scan): flagged a hardcoded credential in an old test file; removed in this PR.
Release Manager: Please add a backfill plan for last 3 releases before merging.
Author (Priya Rao): Backfill plan added to README_RELEASE_MANIFESTS.md and scheduled as a separate workflow.
release_notes: - Add CI jobs to generate SBOMs (syft) and sign artifacts (cosign). - Produce deterministic release-manifests with provenance metadata. - Update private-installer Helm chart and Terraform module to consume release-manifests for offline installs.
security_considerations: Uses KMS-backed cosign signing; keys are never persisted on CI runners. Added automated scans to detect secrets; secret leaked in an old test was removed as part of PR. Operations must ensure KMS key rotation is coordinated with release-manifests re-signing.
